system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: BIGBAGassembles these four inputs into the prompt (see template on our repository), which initializes the agent.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt template with inputs; the template file itself is not in the evidence. The README states: 'Prompt Generation  │  Assemble context: errors + API diff + impacted lines'.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent navigates and reads individual pages on demand rather than receiving the full documentation as a bulk context injection
env_context_strategy.note: The prompt injects context: impacted lines, API diff and file-system references. The agent also navigates with the underlying OpenCode or Gemini CLI tools.

context_compaction.note: Context handling is delegated to the external scaffolds (OpenCode, Gemini CLI). Their config is not in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the agent to invokemvn compile(Apache Maven v3.9.2), read compiler output
observation_format.note: Observations are shell and compiler text, produced through the external scaffolds.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is handled by the external scaffolds OpenCode/GeminiCLI. Their parser is not in the evidence.

tool_count.note: The tool list belongs to the external scaffolds and is not available in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tools come from the scaffolds and are not visible. The produced artifact is an AST transformation program (Spoon/JavaParser), but that is the task output, not the edit primitive.

protocol_standardization.note: The repository source is truncated, so no grep was possible.
